# Git Manager

> Git Manager is an open-source (Apache-2.0) graphical Git management extension, available for two hosts: OpenChamber and VS Code. Features: branch management with recovery, commit history/graph, diff view, multi-criteria filtering, 12 UI languages.

## Pages

- [OpenChamber (zh)](https://guochen-thlg.github.io/git-manage/openchamber/zh/)
- [OpenChamber (en)](https://guochen-thlg.github.io/git-manage/openchamber/en/)
- [VS Code (zh)](https://guochen-thlg.github.io/git-manage/vscode/zh/)
- [VS Code (en)](https://guochen-thlg.github.io/git-manage/vscode/en/)

## Install

- OpenChamber: install from a ZIP, a local build folder, or the Git URL https://github.com/GuoChen-thlg/git-manage.git#release
- VS Code: install from the [Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=thlg.git-manager-vscode), or download a VSIX from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/GuoChen-thlg/git-manage/releases)
